_note: Marks (Yusuf's pick 2026-10-23): a lasting edge one townsperson has, at most one each. A townsperson can arrive with one on a magic or powerful dawn card (sim/card_roll.gd; roles, if given, = the roles it can come on), and warriors earn one by drilling beside a hero on quiet days: the hero's class names the mark (teaches in data/heroes.json), and a warrior who has drilled mark_seconds (warrior data in data/townsfolk.json) earns it. speed, hp, attack = how much more of that stat the person has (0.1 = 10% more); carry = how much more they bring from a trip; gather_mult = how much faster they gather (0.2 = 20%); build = how much faster they raise and craft; upkeep = food they eat beyond (or, below 0, short of) one person's share (-0.5 = half as much). tags describe the mark for later rules, as on any entity. color and shape (diamond, circle or square) are the small marker drawn at the person's feet. sim/folk_ai.gd (take_pupils, _drill_with, grant_mark, apply_folk_stats). short = the few words a rolled card's plaque shows beside the mark's name.
